facts.fact: The Minister of State Modernisation and Public Administration told parliament's first specialised committee on 16 November 2023 that developing an open data portal is a 2024 project of the Digital Transformation of the Public Sector programme, financed by the World Bank, so no portal was running; the document ties it to no open data policy and names no publishing body or dataset count.
